SELECT examQuestionPracticeRecord.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examCourse.course_name AS courseName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examPaper.paper_name AS paperName , examReviewPlan.plan_name AS planName FROM exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper examPaper ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.paper_id = examPaper.id LEFT JOIN exam_review_plan examReviewPlan ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.plan_id = examReviewPlan.id
ORDER BY examQuestionPracticeRecord.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper examPaper ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.paper_id = examPaper.id LEFT JOIN exam_review_plan examReviewPlan ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.plan_id = examReviewPlan.id

SELECT examQuestionPracticeRecord.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examCourse.course_name AS courseName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examPaper.paper_name AS paperName , examReviewPlan.plan_name AS planName FROM exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper examPaper ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.paper_id = examPaper.id LEFT JOIN exam_review_plan examReviewPlan ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.plan_id = examReviewPlan.id
ORDER BY examQuestionPracticeRecord.create_time DESC

SELECT examQuestionPracticeRecord.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examCourse.course_name AS courseName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examPaper.paper_name AS paperName , examReviewPlan.plan_name AS planName FROM exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper examPaper ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.paper_id = examPaper.id LEFT JOIN exam_review_plan examReviewPlan ON examQuestionPracticeRecord.plan_id = examReviewPlan.id WHERE examQuestionPracticeRecord.id = #{id}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.answer_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM exam_question_practice_record r WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.practice_type IN (1, 3) AND r.answer_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.answer_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

SELECT r.course_id AS courseId, IFNULL(MAX(c.course_name), '未知课程') AS courseName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount FROM exam_question_practice_record r LEFT JOIN exam_course c ON r.course_id = c.id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.course_id IS NOT NULL AND r.practice_type IN (1, 3) GROUP BY r.course_id ORDER BY courseName
